Lesson 9 Describe-the-Pictures Exercise
请问，今天几号？ (Qǐngwèn, jīntiān jǐ hào?) - Excuse me, what's the date today?
今天9月1号。 (Jīntiān jiǔ yuè yī hào.) - It's September 1st.
今天星期几？ (Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?) - What day is it today?
星期三。 (Xīngqī sān.) - It's Wednesday.
昨天是几月几号？ (Zuótiān shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?) - What was the date yesterday?
昨天是8月31号，星期二。 (Zuótiān shì bā yuè sānshíyī hào, xīngqī èr.) - It was Tuesday, August 31st.
明天呢？ (Míngtiān ne?) - What about tomorrow?
明天是9月2号，星期四。 (Míngtiān shì jiǔ yuè èr hào, xīngqī sì.) - Tomorrow is Thursday, September 2nd.
明天星期六，你去学校吗？ (Míngtiān xīngqī liù, nǐ qù xuéxiào ma?) - Tomorrow is Saturday. Will you go to school?
我去学校。 (Wǒ qù xuéxiào.) - Yes, I will (I will go to school).
你去学校做什么？ (Nǐ qù xuéxiào zuò shénme?) - What are you going to do there?
我去学校看书。 (Wǒ qù xuéxiào kàn shū.) - I'm going there to do some reading.
9月1号，星期三。 (Jiǔ yuè yī hào, xīngqī sān.) - September 1st, Wednesday.
9月2号，星期四。 (Jiǔ yuè èr hào, xīngqī sì.) - September 2nd, Thursday.
8月31号，星期二。 (Bā yuè sānshíyī hào, xīngqī èr.) - August 31st, Tuesday.
我的汉语老师33岁。 (Wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī sānshísān suì.) - My Chinese teacher is 33 years old.

我们去中国饭馆儿吃中国菜。 (Wǒmen qù Zhōngguó fànguǎnr chī Zhōngguó cài.) - We go to a Chinese restaurant to eat Chinese food.
我去学校看书。 (Wǒ qù xuéxiào kàn shū.) - I go to school to read.
